reply_text:
Found four issues before merge:

1. **[P1] Short text gets truncated too** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`
   `excerpt('hello world', 50)` returns `"hello…"`, and empty input returns `"…"`. There’s no check for text already within the limit.
   **Fix:** Return fitting text unchanged; append the ellipsis only when removing text.

2. **[P2] A word ending exactly at the limit is dropped** — `src/words.js:2–4`
   `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` instead of `"one two…"`, because the space at index `limit` is excluded from the search.
   **Fix:** Include that boundary when searching. The assertion in `test/words.test.js:6` currently locks in the incorrect behavior.

3. **[P2] Markdown stripping deletes literal characters** — `src/plain.js:3`
   `toPlain('snake_case and file_name')` returns `"snakecase and filename"`. Unconditionally removing marker characters corrupts ordinary content.
   **Fix:** Strip parsed formatting rather than every occurrence of those characters; add literal-underscore coverage.

4. **[P2] Cards never use either helper** — `src/card.js:1–2` (unchanged integration point)
   `card()` still returns the full, raw Markdown body. Neither `excerpt` nor `toPlain` has a production caller, so this branch alone doesn’t change card previews.
   **Fix:** Wire plain-text conversion and excerpting into the card path with an explicit limit and an integration test.

All four existing tests pass; the reproductions above expose gaps they don’t catch. No files changed.
